title: DESCRIPTION
source:
*EXAMINATION WORKS:*

* Uploaded  the student's (Birth certificate) on the Eduletics portal.
* Printed the Revision Test Exam Biology, Economics & Maths questions paper for grade X and Maths questions paper for grade XII
* Collected fees from 31 Grade X students and 6 Grade XII students and tallied the physical cash.
* Successfully obtained LOC signatures and verified NO DUES clearance with parents (42) for both Grade X and Grade XII students.
* Prepared Excel sheets for Grade X and verified the Grade XII data with the help of Vivek Sir.
* Given the Grade X Marksheet certificate to the student.(ID-1895, 1862)
* Updated the Excel sheet with the Grade IX registration data.

*OTHER WORK:*

* Dispersal Duty.
* Prepared the Biometric attendance record of Teaching, Non-Teaching, Admin, Transport, Guard and 4th grade employee given by Principal Sir.
* Collected homework feedback from the first-floor classes and shared it via a Google Form.
* Collected notebooks from the following classes:
* 6 DELTA [SANSKRIT]
* 6 IOTA [MATHS]
* 6 IOTA [SANSKRIT]
* 6 OMEGA [SCIENCE]
* 6 OMICRON [SST]
* 6 SIGMA [SANSKRIT]
